scenario review and treatment first; heatmap analysis secondary

procedureBoundaries.monitoring: Observed source is not applicable obligation; proposal is not decision.
procedureBoundaries.incidents: Recorded or internally submitted event is not external notification or legal qualification.
procedureBoundaries.objects: Inventory is not proof of real-world completeness or regulatory applicability.
procedureBoundaries.coverage: Mapping is not conformity; declared control is not verified effectiveness.
procedureBoundaries.actions: Completed is not closed or verified.
procedureBoundaries.risks: Rating is not objective probability or regulatory conclusion.
procedureBoundaries.assurance: Internal approval is not independent assurance or certification.
